title: Tundra Mint
subtitle: Grows where you don't ask it to
note: I don't know how this plant is still not frozen solid, maybe because of its fuzzy exterior(?). Still, there is a lot to research about it. But I don't think it is useful for the cure.
properties: Its core is frozen solid, with a faint glow. And also... a bit prickly despite looking like a soft cotton ball.
Unlike its core, the plant has very soft leaves. They have a fuzzy exterior and feel almost weightless.
hint: The chill lingers even after crushing. I suspect the mortar remembers what the leaf forgets.
